title: standards — the merge-phase standards verdict (review-merge)
description: The review-merge standards reviewer's output (docs/stage-io, task 08). Distinct from backlog's extra_verdict: its findings carry id, severity, files, line and suggestion. The gates only check decision; the schema enforces it (approve|findings|needs_human_review). _io is stamped by the server.

decision.description: approve: nothing worth changing. findings: at least one finding is warranted. needs_human_review: the inputs cannot be judged safely; ends the run at mark_needs_human.

summary.description: One or two sentences stating the verdict and why.

severity.description: How seriously this finding blocks merging.

message.description: What is wrong, which rule or smell it violates, and what must change.

files.description: Repository-relative paths; may be empty but must be present.

line.description: The line of the finding, or null when it has no single line.

suggestion.description: The concrete remediation, not a restatement of the problem.
